title: Rain on Mateo's Window: 8 Hours of Soft Rain + Deep Brown Noise for Sleep
description:
Eight hours of steady rain on Mateo's window, over a deep brown-noise rumble. No thunder, no music, no talking, nothing that jumps out at you. The room light fades to near-dark after five minutes so the screen won't light up your bedroom.

The rain never loops: every minute of it is generated fresh. All sound and picture made from scratch by Sandoval Studios. Goodnight.
